title: Proofpack and Telemetry Notes
content: Proofpack and Telemetry Notes This change adds deterministic, testable orchestration contracts and degraded-state route decisions; see tests in src/lib/control-plane/orchestration.test.ts . Current state: Orchestration route decisions are explainable (reason + rejected reasons + degraded reason). Handoff compaction reports size reduction metrics. Follow-up work can wire these fields into full proofpack generation pipelines
